summary.text: Alexis Calatayud represents Florida Senate District 38, part of Miami-Dade County; Calatayud was elected to the Senate in 2022.

paragraphs.text: According to the Florida Senate's biography, Calatayud was born in Miami and holds a bachelor's degree from Florida International University (2017), where Calatayud was Student Government Association president.
Calatayud has served as a full-voting member of the Florida International University Board of Trustees.
